<thought>Based on the provided precursor pair, the retrosynthetic step likely involves a reaction that forms a C=C double bond (the Doebner modification) while breaking a C‑C and a C‑O bond. Searching the template catalog for forward reactions that form a C=C bond and break C‑C and C‑O bonds should retrieve the appropriate template. The search will be limited to a few results, and the first matching template will be returned with its ID and mapped reaction SMILES.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)O)cc2)cc1",
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C=C"],
    "functional_groups_broken": ["C-C", "C-O"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
